headline: High: Perplexity can ingest and summarize user files while slim has broad filesystem and shell access, creating default-path data leakage and cascading-error risks.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Perplexity ingests uploaded PDFs/images and browsing context, so attacker-controlled content can reach its outputs. slim reads and writes filesystem artifacts and processes Dockerfiles/images, so if Perplexity output is copied into slim’s inputs, instructions can be smuggled across the boundary. No shared channel is documented, so this is inferred rather than directly evidenced.
conditions: IF Perplexity output is pasted into slim prompts or config files, injected instructions can propagate.
IF slim parses Perplexity-generated text as authoritative build guidance, prompt injection becomes actionable.
mitigations: Use a strict copy/paste template that strips instructions from Perplexity output.
Require human review before any Perplexity text is used in slim workflows.
Keep Perplexity summaries in a separate notes file from build inputs.
Add a one-line provenance tag to copied text.
requires-engineering: add content provenance filtering between the tools.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Perplexity touches uploaded documents and browsing context, and its vendor-hosted backend plus vendor-only egress means those contents leave the local environment. slim reads filesystem artifacts and handles registry credentials and private keys, so pairing them can expose sensitive build material to Perplexity if files are shared or summarized. The pairwise leakage path is plausible in default use and the blast radius can include secrets.
conditions: IF a Dockerfile, image artifact, or secret-bearing file from slim is uploaded to Perplexity, that content may be transmitted off-host.
IF Perplexity is used to summarize slim outputs containing credentials or keys, those secrets can leak into vendor-hosted context.
mitigations: Do not upload secret-bearing artifacts to Perplexity.
Redact keys and credentials before any Perplexity analysis.
Keep slim workspaces separate from Perplexity-uploaded files.
Review Perplexity sharing/export settings before use.
requires-engineering: route sensitive files through a local-only analysis path.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Perplexity has no filesystem write or shell execution, while slim has shell, subprocess, read/write filesystem, and broad network egress. They do not directly contend for the same mutable resource by profile, but slim can modify local artifacts that Perplexity may later read via uploads, creating overlapping writes/reads on shared files if the operator bridges them. Uncertainty keeps this above low.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same working directory, slim can overwrite files that Perplexity later ingests.
IF the operator uses Perplexity-generated files as slim inputs without locking, race conditions can corrupt artifacts.
mitigations: Use separate directories for Perplexity and slim.
Avoid concurrent edits to the same files.
Snapshot inputs before handing them to slim.
Check file hashes before and after slim runs.
requires-engineering: add workspace locking or orchestration-level coordination.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity produces cited answers from browsing context, and slim is an interactive CLI that can execute commands and alter container artifacts. If slim treats Perplexity’s output as authoritative, a mistaken summary can cascade into destructive image changes or unsafe cleanup. The pathway is plausible but not proven by direct interaction evidence, so medium is appropriate.
conditions: IF slim operators copy Perplexity recommendations into commands without verification, errors can propagate into builds.
IF Perplexity hallucinates a Docker fix and slim executes it, the resulting image may be broken or insecure.
mitigations: Verify Perplexity claims against primary docs before acting.
Run slim changes on a disposable image first.
Require a second human check for destructive commands.
Keep a rollback copy of the original image.
requires-engineering: add automated validation before slim executes suggested changes.

E_compliance.rationale: Perplexity is vendor-hosted and processes uploaded documents and browsing context, while slim handles registry credentials, private keys, and filesystem artifacts in a local container session. If regulated data from slim is sent to Perplexity, residency and retention obligations may be violated. The other agent is not cited for a specific residency mismatch because slim’s profile does not declare one.
conditions: IF regulated data from slim is uploaded to Perplexity, vendor-hosted processing may violate policy.
IF Perplexity retention settings are not aligned with the data class, compliance gaps can occur.
mitigations: Do not send regulated data to Perplexity.
Confirm retention settings before uploading any file.
Strip secrets from slim artifacts before analysis.
Keep an audit log of what was uploaded.
requires-engineering: implement a data-class policy gate for uploads.
